_comment: Generator-owned configuration, deliberately kept OUTSIDE docs_preview_overlay.json so that
the overlay can be replaced wholesale by real discovery output (post preview enrollment)
without losing this metadata and without generator changes.
suggest_mode_unsupported: batchUpdate Request-union members that must NOT get a write_mode
parameter. The first eight are the official 'Unsupported requests in suggest mode' list from
The comment/suggestion thread operations are also excluded: they act on threads directly and
are not content edits, so SUGGEST write mode does not apply to them (overlay decision,
unverified against the live preview API).
suggest_mode_partial: members that accept SUGGEST but with restrictions, noted in docstrings.

suggest_mode_partial.updateDocumentStyle: SUGGEST mode does not support the documentFormat, useEvenPageHeaderFooter, or useFirstPageHeaderFooter style fields.
